summary: ISO / UTS threaded screw sized by spec string "<size>,<length>" ("M3,10"); head type by option, headless by default.

options.head: "socket", "hex", "button", "flat", "pan", "cheese", or "none" (default)
options.length: length under the head in mm, overriding the spec

checks.source: ISO 4762 M3x10: dk 5.5, k 3, length under head 10
